const readSessionNativeBacking = `-- name: ReadSessionNativeBacking :one
SELECT effective.allocation_id, effective.root_id, effective.policy_json, effective.rows_limit, effective.keys_limit, effective.transitions_per_row, effective.charged_rows, effective.charged_keys, effective.backup_horizon_seconds, effective.cleanup_seconds, effective.valid_until, effective.retire_by, effective.residual_until, effective.overdue FROM artifact_download s
JOIN download_native_backing b ON b.allocation_id=s.allocation_id AND b.root_id=s.root_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL capacity_session_native(s,b) effective
WHERE s.id=$1 AND s.root_id=$2
`

type ReadSessionNativeBackingParams struct {
	ID     pgtype.UUID
	RootID pgtype.UUID
}

UPDATE download_native_owner SET closed=true,retired_at=instant.now,updated_at=instant.now,updates=updates+1 FROM instant
WHERE worker_id=$1 AND root_id=$2 AND retired_at IS NULL
